exact_formula: median3 v_s then centered finite-difference a_s; count merged intervals with a_s<=-0.80
numerical_threshold: brake onset=-0.80 m/s2; release=-0.20 m/s2; merge gap=0.3 s
hysteresis: enter brake at -0.80; exit only after a_s>=-0.20 for 0.3 s
expected_noise_sensitivity: Median3 lowers isolated speed noise but can delay a sharp onset
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Median span and durations are seconds at dt=0.1 and require resampling
edge_cases: filter boundary; v_s<1.0 m/s for 0.5 s; missing route tangent; no valid phase
rationale: Onset lies near raw longitudinal acceleration q05 of Stage6J and Stage6K while avoiding one-frame excursions

exact_formula: median5 v_s then centered finite-difference a_s; count merged intervals with a_s<=-1.00
numerical_threshold: brake onset=-1.00 m/s2; release=-0.10 m/s2; merge gap=0.4 s
hysteresis: enter brake at -1.00; exit only after a_s>=-0.10 for 0.3 s
physical_interpretation: Conservative count of sustained stronger braking
expected_noise_sensitivity: Median5 is robust to high-frequency speed noise but can merge close phases
sampling_rate_sensitivity: All spans and durations are physical seconds not frame counts
edge_cases: filter boundary; low-speed end-stop; phase shorter than 0.5 s; nonfinite v_s
rationale: Threshold is within the raw q01-to-q05 braking range and emphasizes clear phase separation

exact_formula: unfiltered v_s finite difference with three-frame median a_s; count merged intervals with a_s<=-0.60
numerical_threshold: brake onset=-0.60 m/s2; release=0.00 m/s2; merge gap=0.5 s
hysteresis: enter brake at -0.60; exit only after a_s>=0.00 for 0.4 s
physical_interpretation: Sensitive to sustained brake-release-brake with positive release
expected_noise_sensitivity: Acceleration filter may retain speed quantization sensitivity but longer dwell limits false phases
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Derivative and dwell must be reconstructed in seconds when dt changes
edge_cases: zero-speed stop; acceleration sign chattering; horizon truncation
rationale: Low onset is paired with strict positive release and long persistence

exact_formula: for first two OPTION_A phases: max v_s in release gap minus v_s at first-phase end divided by max of first-phase start speed minus first-phase minimum speed and 0.1 m/s
numerical_threshold: denominator floor=0.1 m/s; use OPTION_A segmentation
minimum_duration: release gap must be at least 0.3 s
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_A enter and exit thresholds
physical_interpretation: Relative recovery of speed between two material brake phases
expected_noise_sensitivity: Maximum gap speed is susceptible to one-frame noise but median3 speed reduces this
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Gap duration and derivative settings use physical seconds
edge_cases: less than two phases; first loss below 0.1 m/s; low-speed end-stop; truncated second phase
rationale: Normalizes recovery by the first realized speed loss without using representation outcome

exact_formula: for first two OPTION_B phases: median v_s over final 0.2 s of release gap minus median v_s over final 0.2 s of phase one divided by max of phase-one start median minus phase-one minimum median and 0.1 m/s
numerical_threshold: denominator floor=0.1 m/s; use OPTION_B segmentation
minimum_duration: release gap must be at least 0.4 s
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_B enter and exit thresholds
physical_interpretation: Robust terminal-gap release relative to initial braking loss
expected_noise_sensitivity: Two short medians reduce peak noise but may understate sharp release
sampling_rate_sensitivity: 0.2 s medians and 0.4 s gap must be converted by seconds
edge_cases: less than two phases; low speed; phase/gap too short; missing frames
rationale: Median summaries match the conservative phase option and avoid a single peak

exact_formula: for first two OPTION_C phases: positive integral of a_s over release interval divided by absolute negative integral of a_s over phase one
numerical_threshold: integral denominator floor=0.05 m/s; use OPTION_C segmentation
minimum_duration: release interval must be at least 0.4 s
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_C enter and exit thresholds
expected_noise_sensitivity: Integration accumulates low-frequency bias but is less dependent on a single speed sample
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Integrals are over seconds and must use actual timestamp spacing
edge_cases: less than two phases; nonfinite acceleration; low-speed end-stop; denominator floor
rationale: Directly measures release impulse relative to braking impulse

exact_formula: max of -a_s in second OPTION_A phase divided by max of -a_s in first OPTION_A phase
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_A enter and exit thresholds
physical_interpretation: Relative intensity of second braking phase
expected_noise_sensitivity: Peak is sensitive to residual derivative noise; median3 speed limits isolated noise
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Peak is evaluated on timestamp-aware derivative; minimum duration stays 0.3 s
edge_cases: less than two phases; denominator floor; low-speed end-stop; truncated phase
rationale: Uses same explicit onset definition as phase count

exact_formula: 95th percentile of -a_s within second OPTION_B phase divided by 95th percentile of -a_s within first OPTION_B phase
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_B enter and exit thresholds
physical_interpretation: Robust high-braking ratio rather than single derivative peak
expected_noise_sensitivity: Less sensitive to one sample but needs enough phase frames
sampling_rate_sensitivity: Percentiles require a duration expressed in seconds; at dt=0.1 five frames is the minimum
edge_cases: less than two phases; fewer than five frames; low speed; denominator floor
rationale: Matches the conservative duration option and raw q01-to-q05 braking scale

exact_formula: mean of -a_s over the most negative contiguous 0.3 s subinterval of second OPTION_C phase divided by the same quantity in first phase
hysteresis: inherits OPTION_C enter and exit thresholds
expected_noise_sensitivity: Window mean reduces derivative quantization but can miss a very narrow peak
sampling_rate_sensitivity: 0.3 s subinterval must be rebuilt in physical time
edge_cases: less than two phases; phase shorter than 0.3 s; low speed; denominator floor
rationale: Pairs a sustained intensity definition with the sensitive segmentation option
